svg.text: AUTH FLOWS · 6 PATHS · JWT · REFRESH TOKENS · API KEYS · RBAC
bcrypt.verify() → sign JWT → gen refresh token
C. TOKEN REFRESH / POST /v1/auth/refresh (family rotation + reuse detection)
mark old used_at · INSERT new (same family_id)
sign new access token · return new refresh token
D. PASSWORD RESET / 2-step · no email enumeration
if user found: INSERT auth_tokens (1h TTL)
confirm: validate hash · bcrypt new pw
E. INVITATION / admin creates · anyone accepts · out-of-band token delivery
F. API KEY AUTH / X-Api-Key header · always role=member · ownerPool hash lookup
TTL: max 900s (15 min) / short; no revocation list needed
Stateless: never stored server-side. Verify in makeAuthenticate() only.
Signing secret from Secrets Manager. Min 32 chars, validated at boot.
owner (3): all ops incl. org cancel, role changes, billing
admin (2): billing, invitations, API keys, exports, team roles
member (1): project CRUD · API key requests (always role=member)
403 FORBIDDEN if req.auth.role numeric < required minimum
Last-owner guard: cannot demote or remove sole remaining owner
Cancelled org: withTenant checks deleted_at → 403 before RBAC
withTenant (preHandler[3]) sets GUC → RLS auto-scopes ALL queries on req.db to tenant. Deleted org → 403.
